prompt: Starting from the Aurora spectrograph's kickoff note (/projects/aurora/kickoff.md), list the project's milestones in sequence order through the last one. The sequence is defined by the `after:` frontmatter field — each milestone names the milestone immediately before it — and NOT by dates (one milestone slipped, so date order differs). Give the titles in sequence order, numbered. Include only Aurora's own milestones; do not list milestones of other projects even if they mention Aurora. Change nothing.

must_mention: /Aurora kickoff[\s\S]*Science requirements signed off[\s\S]*Optical design review[\s\S]*Grating procurement[\s\S]*Detector cooldown test[\s\S]*Slit mask fabrication[\s\S]*Bench alignment[\s\S]*Integration with the dome[\s\S]*First light[\s\S]*Throughput calibration[\s\S]*Aurora closeout/

args.query: select _path, title, $depth, $frontier from docs where _path == "/projects/aurora/kickoff.md" follow ^docs collect { where after == ^_path depth 8 } order by $ordinal
select _path, title, $depth, $frontier from docs where _path == "/projects/aurora/integration-with-dome.md" follow ^docs collect { where after == ^_path depth 8 } order by $ordinal

solution.final_text:

4. Grating procurement
5. Detector cooldown test
6. Slit mask fabrication
7. Bench alignment
8. Integration with the dome
9. First light

notes: Graph traversal along a frontmatter relation. `after:` names the note BEFORE this one (Brendan's `terms/fields/after.md`: 'the documents that come before this one in a sequence'; each note carries one side), so the forward walk is the inverse relation — `follow ^docs collect { where after == ^_path }` (spec/oqx §follow: a destination block computes the successors per frontier row). OQX caps a walk at depth 8 (the seed is depth 1), so an 11-note chain takes two walks: the first ends on `Integration with the dome` with `$frontier: true`, the second re-seeds from it. `refs(after)` walks the chain backwards from the closeout just as well. The date decoy: `Detector cooldown test` (when 2027-01-29) slipped past `Slit mask fabrication` (2026-12-18), so `order by when` is wrong and the check's regex pins the chain order. The sibling decoy: cirrus's `Dome slit alignment to the spectrograph` is tagged `aurora` and names Aurora in its body (a grep for 'aurora' finds it) but is not in the chain (cirrus also has a bare `Design review` near Aurora's `Optical design review`, a name decoy the check cannot forbid without forbidding the right answer). On bare files: grep the ten `after:` lines and the eleven `title:` lines under projects/aurora/ and chain them by hand — no file name carries an ordinal.
